workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad. Thanks for checking. I've cross-referenced the times you provided with Priya's and Marcus's calendars, and unfortunately, none of them are free. It seems we don't have a match.

You didn't mention any times on Wednesday. Priya and Marcus are both free from 15:00 to 16:00 on Wednesday. Could you check if either 15:00 or 15:30 works for Elena and David?

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Thanks Alison. I've checked and unfortunately Wednesday 15:00 doesn't work for David (he has a Partner lunch) and 15:30 doesn't work for either of them.

It looks like there are no 30-minute slots where all four partners are currently free. I've found two times that are the 'closest fits', where only one person has a conflict:

1. Wed 15:00: Priya, Marcus and Elena are free. Only David is busy (Partner lunch).
2. Thu 10:00: Priya, Marcus and David are free. Only Elena is busy (1:1 with associate).

Both of these conflicts seem like they might be moveable. Do you have a preference from your side? Once you confirm, I can see if Elena or David can reschedule.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Thanks for finding those, Brad. Both of those times work for Priya and Marcus.

I agree with your assessment. A 1:1 meeting seems more likely to be moveable than a partner lunch. Please go ahead and ask Elena if she can reschedule her 1:1 on Thursday at 10:00. If she can, I'll create the booking immediately.
